summary.intent: Enhance the summary TUI detail pane to show all available session data (scores, stats, files, tool usage, facets with evidence), fix the repo filter showing nothing, and address copy/scroll UX issues.
summary.outcome: All missing data was added to the detail pane in a compact grouped layout (4 boxes: SUMMARY, CODE, LEARNINGS, SIGNALS). The repo filter was fixed to load its own independent 200-session query. Mouse capture was removed to allow highlight-copy; keyboard scrolling (pgup/pgdn/ctrl+u/ctrl+d) handles detail pane navigation. Memory loop outcome logic was also fixed (temporal split on LastInjectedAt) and 5 incorrectly-marked ineffective records were reset to neutral.

repo: The summary TUI loads only 200 most recent sessions; the repo filter previously reused those rows, so feature-branch sessions had zero overlap with main-reachable checkpoints
Memory loop DeriveOutcomes logic was inverted: any injected memory with token overlap against ANY session was marked ineffective, including pre-injection sessions
WizardIntentEdit in the memory-loop TUI was defined but never handled in the backend switch statement; the edit flow was a documented gap
tea.WithMouseCellMotion() captures all mouse events, preventing terminal text selection; removing it restores highlight-copy while keyboard scroll keys still work
insightsdb.QueryByCheckpointIDs exists as a query method for fetching sessions by a set of checkpoint IDs

code.finding: Unhandled keys fall through to the viewport, so pgup/pgdn/ctrl+u/ctrl+d scroll the detail pane without explicit handling
Old outcome logic: overlap>0 AND InjectCount>0 → ineffective; overlap>0 AND InjectCount==0 → reinforced. Both cases were wrong — no temporal split on LastInjectedAt
renderSubSection helper added; spacing between sub-sections controlled by prepending a blank line when currentLen>0

workflow: Codex adversarial review companion hits ENOBUFS on large repos — the git diff buffer overflows; not a spec quality issue
Subagent-driven development pattern: dispatch per-task subagents, orchestrator handles integration tasks directly when they require coordinating changes across multiple files simultaneously
The brainstorming skill generates visual companion mockups at localhost:65000; approach selection (flat/tabbed/collapsible) done via HTML mockup before spec writing

friction: Codex adversarial review failed with ENOBUFS on both foreground and background runs due to repo size
replace_all on renderSubSection call sites mixed up parameter order (currentLen placed in title position), requiring manual correction
Mouse capture for scroll wheel prevented terminal highlight-copy; required two iterations (remove mouse entirely → restore scroll-only keyboard nav) before landing on correct solution
The copy-to-clipboard feature (y key) was implemented then removed after user clarified they wanted highlight-copy, not full-pane copy
open_items: Staged changes in memory_loop_cmd.go, memory_loop_cmd_test.go, memoryloop/generator.go not yet committed at session end
Unstaged changes in summarytui/root.go not yet committed at session end
Memory loop outcome re-evaluation: existing records reset to neutral but not yet re-scored; requires running 'entire memory-loop refresh'
Memory loop edit wizard uses a simple huh form but the original intent was a richer interactive edit; marked as intentionally deferred
implementation_rationale: 4-box grouped layout (SUMMARY/CODE/LEARNINGS/SIGNALS) chosen over flat-scroll or tabbed to balance information density with readability; compact grouping reduces box count from 17 to 4
Repo filter fix uses a separate DB query (QueryByCheckpointIDs) rather than expanding the shared 200-session load, so each view independently gets its 200 most recent relevant sessions
Outcome temporal fix splits sessions on LastInjectedAt per record — only post-injection friction counts as evidence of ineffectiveness; no post-injection sessions yet → neutral (can't evaluate)
Mouse capture removed entirely rather than adding a toggle; keyboard scroll keys (pgup/pgdn) already handled by viewport fallthrough, making mouse scroll redundant
tradeoffs: Flat scroll chosen over tabbed/collapsible detail pane — simpler, no hidden state, matches existing TUI paradigm
Compact grouped boxes (B layout) chosen over separate-box-per-section (A) or hybrid header (C) — fewer boxes, related data co-located
Removing mouse capture loses scroll-wheel support but enables highlight-copy; keyboard alternatives (pgup/pgdn/ctrl+u/ctrl+d) cover the scroll use case
Non-injected memories now always stay neutral instead of potentially being marked reinforced — conservative choice since you can't claim injection credit for something never injected
codebase_patterns: summarytui detail rendering uses lipgloss styles passed through a styles struct; renderSubSection/renderEvidence helpers follow the same pattern
huh forms used for interactive TUI input (trail_cmd.go pattern); NewAccessibleForm wrapper used consistently
insightsdb query methods follow a sessionColumns + JOIN pattern; new QueryByCheckpointIDs added following existing QueryByCheckpointPrefix conventions
TUI model separates branchRows and repoRows as distinct slices; applyFilter selects the active source based on branchFilter state
Memory loop records use LastInjectedAt timestamp for temporal reasoning about injection effectiveness
